judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer does not flag the Buschmann:2021juv citation or the claim about red-giant-branch tip / axion-electron coupling at all. No mention of the mis-attributed topic in Section 2.

The review does not mention Buschmann:2021juv, the axion-electron versus axion-nucleon claim, red-giant-branch bounds, or any contradiction between the cited source and the sentence. General bibliography complaints are not specific enough under the citation detection rules.

The reviewer identifies several malformed citations and incorrect years in the bibliography (specifically Refs 6, 7, 13, 26, 27), but none of these correspond to the Buschmann:2021juv reference or the specific topic misattribution regarding axion-electron coupling and red giant branch luminosity.
The reviewer makes no mention of the internal inconsistency between the two axion mass thresholds (10^{-9} vs 10^{-8} eV) in Section 3.1, nor does it reference the SMM coupling bound value.
The reviewer does not flag the inconsistent axion-mass threshold in Section 3.1, nor quote or discuss the 10^-9 versus 10^-8 eV discrepancy. No specific numerical inconsistency is identified.

The reviewer provides a content-related comment on Section 3.1 regarding the abruptness of the transition to BNS mergers, but fails to mention the numerical inconsistency between the 10^-9 and 10^-8 eV mass thresholds stated in the same section.
The reviewer does not flag the wrong figure cross-reference for the 'Low-Energy SNe' region; there is no mention of Fig.~ref{fig:CoolingBound} or a mislabeled figure reference in Section 3.2.

There is no comment about the 'Low-Energy SNe' label, Fig. CoolingBound, Fig. boundsgag, or any cross-reference mismatch in Section 3.2. The figure-related comment concerns licensing only, not incorrect figure references.

The reviewer identifies several minor typographical errors in Section 3.2 but does not flag the incorrect figure cross-reference where the text refers to a 'Low-Energy SNe' region in Figure 1 instead of Figure 2.
